dashboards.metric.attack_paths_to_crown_: Crown jewels in scope that a public entry point reaches through known relationships, or that are entry points themselves, ranked by path score.
dashboards.metric.brief_weekly.definitio: Up to three sentences built from this dashboard's snapshot with fixed wording: new against fixed findings in the last 7 days, the biggest lever, and the P0–P2 findings due soon or past their SLA. Every figure with a list opens it. No AI is involved.
dashboards.metric.brief_weekly.name: This week in brief
dashboards.metric.certificates_expiry.de: Certificates in scope that have expired or expire within 7, 30 or 90 days. Each band opens those certificates.
dashboards.metric.coverage_discovery.def: Share of the assets the coverage ledger tracks in scope that had a successful discovery run in the last 30 days. Blocked or failed runs do not count. Opens the assets not covered.
dashboards.metric.crown_jewels_exposed.d: Crown jewels in scope with at least one open P0 or P1 finding (or the priorities the widget filters on). Opens those findings grouped by asset.
dashboards.metric.ctem_loop.definition: The five CTEM stages for your scope: crown jewels designated, assets with a successful scan in the last 30 days, open P0 and KEV findings, open findings with validation evidence, and the share within SLA. Each figure opens the list it counts.
dashboards.metric.ctem_loop.name: The CTEM loop
dashboards.metric.exceptions_expiring.de: Accepted findings by when their risk acceptance ends. When it ends the finding reopens, so plan the review before then. Each band opens those findings.
dashboards.metric.exposure_flow.definiti: Where findings come from and where they go, for the period: what each source sent, received to actionable, actionable by priority class, the five CTEM stages and the outcomes. Source figures are organization figures; every other figure is counted in your scope. Each figure opens the list it counts.
dashboards.metric.exposure_flow.name: Exposure flow
dashboards.metric.exposure_kpis.definiti: Five figures in one strip, each counted exactly as its own widget: P0–P1 open, known exploited open, open within SLA, median time to fix in the period and discovery coverage. A figure that cannot be measured says so; it never shows 0.
dashboards.metric.exposure_kpis.name: Key figures
dashboards.metric.exposure_levers.defini: Up to three actions, ranked by the risk points they clear (P0 8, P1 4, P2 2, P3 1): fix the known-exploited findings, fix the P0–P1 findings past their SLA, apply the proposed remediation that closes the most risk, and cover the tracked assets with no successful scan (shown last while coverage is under 90 %). Each effect is exact: the figure before and after the list it opens is gone, each lever on its own. Counted in your scope.
dashboards.metric.exposure_levers.name: What would cut exposure most
dashboards.metric.exposure_open_by_prior: The open P0 to P2 findings at the end of each period, by priority class.
dashboards.metric.exposure_priority_open: Open P0 and P1 findings: exploitable or likely exploitable on assets that matter.
dashboards.metric.findings_age_bands.def: Open findings by severity and how long they have been open (days since first detected).
dashboards.metric.findings_open.definiti: Published findings that are open now (not fixed, not dispositioned), in this dashboard's scope.
dashboards.metric.findings_open.name: Open findings
dashboards.metric.fix_next.definition: Open P0 to P2 findings in fix order: priority, then severity, then newest.
dashboards.metric.fix_next.name: Fix next
dashboards.metric.fix_time_to_fix.defini: Median and 90th percentile of the time from first detection to fix, for findings fixed in the period.
dashboards.metric.fix_time_to_fix.name: Time to fix
dashboards.metric.flow_new_vs_fixed.defi: Findings first detected and findings fixed in each period. Fixing more than you find shrinks exposure.
dashboards.metric.flow_new_vs_fixed.name: New vs fixed
dashboards.metric.ingest_intake.definiti: What each source sent in the period and what {product} did with it: new or reopened, merged into findings that exist, suppressed by an approved rule, or not stored. Organization figures, from the import and run receipts; each figure opens those receipts.
dashboards.metric.ingest_intake.name: Intake and noise reduction
dashboards.metric.intel_kev_open.definit: Open findings whose vulnerability is in the known exploited vulnerabilities catalog (KEV).
dashboards.metric.intel_kev_open.name: KEV on your assets
dashboards.metric.sla_at_risk.definition: Open P0 to P2 findings with the nearest SLA deadline first.
dashboards.metric.sla_at_risk.name: SLA at risk
dashboards.metric.sla_within.definition: Share of open findings with an SLA that are not past their deadline. Findings without an SLA are left out.
dashboards.metric.sla_within.name: Open within SLA
dashboards.metric.surface_new_assets.def: Assets added to the inventory in the period, by type, with the period before. Each type opens the assets of that type added since the period started.
